metadata.description: Workflow YAML creator plugin for the jobworkerp-rs workflow DSL (Open Workflow DSL v1.0.0 based)

plugins.name: jobworkerp-workflow
plugins.description: Create and edit workflow YAML for the jobworkerp-rs workflow DSL (based on Open Workflow DSL v1.0.0 with jobworkerp extensions). Supports built-in runners, MCP servers, plugin runners, call http/grpc tasks, process tasks, flow control, and jq/Liquid runtime expressions.
